claims_checked.claim: Tipping is not customary in most everyday Japanese restaurants.
Staff may return tip cash believing it is forgotten change.
claims_checked.note: Widely reported traveler/staff experience; framed as common outcome, not universal.

claims_checked.claim: Printed service charges can appear for groups, private rooms, or luxury dining.
claims_checked.note: Advise reading the bill; do not invent percentages.

claims_checked.claim: No-tipping custom does not by itself prove a specific national wage level.

caveats_about_absolutes: Do not romanticize omotenashi as mystical or tip-incompatible spirituality.
notes: Human review required before publish; status remains review.
